d: India’s digital payments boom has pushed UPI to record highs, but cash remains deeply entrenched, with currency held by the public reaching about ₹41.8 lakh crore. At the same time, India faces renewed pressure from Washington over its Russian oil imports, as a US sanctions bill could pave the way for tariffs of up to 100% on major buyers of Russian crude. From India’s cash-versus-UPI paradox to the growing US–India–Russia tensions, Hem Saroya explains the latest developments on Vantage on Firstpost.
